content_of_post_to_answer: What is one simple habit that can completely change your life?
answer: A life-changing habit is often less about what you add and more about what you stop ignoring. A few minutes of honest reflection each day can reveal patterns before they become problems. I’ve explored this idea in more detail on my profile for anyone who wants to go deeper. The biggest changes rarely come from dramatic decisions; they come from noticing small truths early enough to act on them.
